doc.title: Jonathan Scales interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 23, 2025

title: A planned book on composition and philosophy
summary: He is beginning a book on composition that doubles as philosophy.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: It’s interesting that you say that because I’m like kind of starting to write a book. I’m in the early process of writing a book about composition. But I want it to double as a philosophy book. So my goal right now, I want to write a book that if you are studying music composition you can read it and you can glean things from it that will help you and open your mind with your own writing process. But if you know nothing about music then you can walk away with some type of philosophy. That’s my goal and it’s in the very beginning stages of that. But it might take me a few years to actually pull that off but it’s on my mind.
